content: Meera Chauhan inquired about using her expired travel policy (TRV-2024-0789) for an upcoming October 2026 trip. Agent Ravi Menon informed her that the policy cannot be reactivated, but offered to issue a new one effective October 10, 2026. Ravi instructed Meera to complete the online renewal form, pay the premium, and upload a copy of her passport and trip itinerary.

action_items: Fill out the online renewal form at https://securefuturegroup.com/travel/renew
Pay the premium for the new policy
Upload a copy of the passport and trip itinerary
